items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Right, it started with a motif that I thought fitted the character that Julie Andrews played.

ctx.x: Right, it started with a motif that I thought fitted the character that Julie Andrews played. You know [sings Emily, Emily] I wanted to get kind of a sort of a purity in a nice ethereal way, type of feeling, it seemed to capsulize what she was to me at that time. And the song just kind of spun itself out one night.
Gene Lees tells a nice story about, The Singers Unlimited, recording of that tune.
